args.title: Allow re-clicking the Export button after a failed export in src/config.ts
args.body: Issue 4192 describes a bug where the Export button remains greyed out after a failed export, preventing the user from attempting to export again without refreshing the page. To resolve this issue, we will modify the logic for enabling the Export button in the export handling functionality within the src/config.ts file. This change will ensure that users can retry an export without needing to refresh the entire application.
